skill.name: file-organizer
skill.description: Organizes local files and folders by analyzing structure, finding duplicates, proposing cleanup plans, and guiding approved moves or archives.
skill.summary: Plan and execute safer file organization with duplicate review and cleanup guidance.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: All static detections were false positives caused by Markdown code fences or inline example paths. I found no prompt injection, network exfiltration, or hidden execution intent. The skill still has legitimate operational risk because it guides local scans, moves, renames, and possible duplicate deletion.

remediation.issue: File moves and deletions can cause data loss.
remediation.suggestion: Require dry-run plans, explicit per-batch approval, and a move log before running changes.

remediation.issue: Broad folder scans can expose sensitive file names and metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to exclude sensitive folders and limit scans to the requested directory.

remediation.issue: Shell command examples use placeholder paths.
remediation.suggestion: Quote user paths and validate target directories before running generated commands.

content.user_title: Organize Files and Clean Up Folders
content.value_statement: Messy folders make files harder to find and storage harder to manage. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through safe analysis, duplicate review, and organized cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Analyze target directories for file types, sizes, dates, and folder structure.
Find likely duplicate files by name, size, or file hash.
Propose folder structures by type, project, purpose, or date.
Create step-by-step cleanup plans before files are moved.
Guide approved folder creation, file moves, renames, and archive actions.
Provide maintenance tips after organization work is complete.
limitations: Requires access to local folders through the agent environment.
File moves and deletions need explicit user review before execution.
Duplicate detection can miss similar files that are not exact matches.
Large directories may take time to scan and summarize.

use_cases.title: Clean a Downloads folder
use_cases.description: Sort mixed downloads into documents, images, installers, archives, and review queues with a clear approval step.

use_cases.title: Review project directories
use_cases.description: Separate active projects from archived work and recommend a consistent structure for future projects.

use_cases.title: Prepare files for archive
use_cases.description: Identify old files, organize reference material, and move uncertain items into an archive instead of deleting them.

prompt_templates.title: Clean One Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cleanup for a single messy folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me organize my Downloads folder. First inspect the contents, then propose a safe plan before moving anything.

prompt_templates.title: Find Duplicate Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Review possible duplicate files before removal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find duplicate files in my Documents folder. Show each duplicate set and recommend which copy to keep before deletion.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a project workspace without immediate changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Projects folder and suggest a better structure for active work, archived work, and templates. Do not move files yet.

prompt_templates.title: Run Staged Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup with conservative execution controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged cleanup plan for this folder. Include exclusions, a move log, conflict handling, and approval checkpoints for every batch.

output_examples.input: My Downloads folder has hundreds of mixed files. Help me organize it.
output: A summary of file counts, major file types, size groups, and old items.
A proposed folder plan for documents, images, installers, archives, and items needing review.
A confirmation question before any folder creation or file movement.

output_examples.input: Find duplicate files in my Documents folder.
output: A grouped list of duplicate candidates with paths, sizes, and modified dates.
A recommendation for the copy to keep based on location and freshness.
A request for approval before deleting or archiving any duplicate copy.

output_examples.input: Review my Projects folder and suggest improvements.
output: A description of current structure issues and old project candidates.
A suggested structure for active work, archived years, and templates.
A staged migration plan that waits for approval before implementation.

best_practices: Start with one folder and review the proposed plan before changes.
Keep archives for uncertain files instead of deleting them.
Ask for a move log so changes can be reversed if needed.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad cleanup on your full home directory without exclusions.
Do not delete duplicate files until each set is reviewed.
Do not move active project folders while related apps are open.

faq.question: Can this skill delete files automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to ask before deleting anything. Review every deletion plan before approval.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code environments that can inspect local files.

faq.question: Can it organize photos by date?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose year and month folders using file dates or available photo metadata.

faq.question: How does it find duplicates?
faq.answer: It can compare file names, sizes, and exact hashes when the environment supports those commands.

faq.question: Should I use it on sensitive folders?
faq.answer: Use explicit exclusions for sensitive folders. Limit scans to the smallest directory that solves the task.

faq.question: Can I undo changes?
faq.answer: Request a move log before execution. A clear log helps restore files if the plan needs reversal.
